name: Owly
description: Self-hosted AI customer-support agent that replies to customers over WhatsApp, email and phone from one dashboard.
whatItDoes: Handles incoming customer messages and calls for a small business, answering from stored business information and logging every conversation. Owners manage channels, tickets and settings in a web admin.
howItWorks: A TypeScript web application with a Prisma-managed database connects channel adapters to a language model. It starts with Docker Compose or a local Node workflow, and a chat endpoint allows other systems to send messages to the agent.

requirements.name: Docker
requirements.description: Compose setup; Node.js is the alternative for local development

requirements.name: LLM provider key
requirements.description: Set in the .env file copied from the example
